name: ShipProtect ShippingProtection
summary: Shopify shipping protection box for the cart: percentage, fixed or dynamic fee, toggle or checkbox layout and pre-tick options, with the premiums kept by the store.
best_for: Shopify stores that want to add their own shipping protection fee at the cart and keep the premium
skip_if: you want a provider that handles claims and replacements for you, or your cart is a drawer app other than Monster Cart Upsells
honest_knock: The app does not handle claims, so the risk of lost or damaged parcels stays with you. In our test the box did not show in a different cart drawer app, the terms link pointed to google.com until we changed it, and uninstalling left a product with 100 variants behind. The listing also carries a review that reports fraudulent purchases of the cheapest protection option.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 22 November 2026 on a Shopify development store, with the interface in English. We installed ShipProtect, approved its test charge (no card, not billed), set the protection box up in the theme editor and ticked it on a cart. We placed no order.
findings: Install: the app asked to approve a subscription with a 10 day free trial and $9.99 every 30 days; on a development store this was a test charge that is not billed.

Default rule: 5% of the cart, minimum charge $5, steps of $2, maximum $201. On a $3,128.30 cart the box offered $157.00, and ticking it moved the subtotal to $3,285.30. The box was not ticked by default.
Terms link: the tooltip links to google.com until you set your own terms page.
Other cart drawer: the box did not show inside the cart drawer of another cart app in our store. The app's FAQ says it works only with Monster Cart Upsells as a drawer.
Removal: uninstalling left a 'Shipping Protection' product with 100 price variants in the catalogue, which we deleted by hand.
not_tested: a real order through checkout with protection (the store is password protected and we placed no order)
the Button layout (Beta) and the checkout protection rule
a claim or refund after a lost parcel, which the app does not handle
the storefront outside the theme editor preview
